agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Turn 5 voluntarily switched burned 16-HP Lildozer to full Croakatoa even though Ponyta's verified critical bound exceeded Croakatoa's 44 HP.

resolution.observed: Reloaded the exact state with behavior 4ef8a6d6: all five unsafe voluntary switches were vetoed, priority Ice Shard dealt verified damage, and Lildozer absorbed the KO without exposing a reserve.

findings.why_bad: The switch paid a full enemy attack for no allied action and converted a depleted active into damage on a healthy reserve.
findings.improvement: Unsafe voluntary switches can no longer be authorized by a preference; when the active is guaranteed to faint, a move that acts first outranks damage that cannot execute.
findings.next_test: Require no unsafe voluntary switch in the next full clone.

findings.summary: After Croakatoa fainted, its normal-turn Mud Shot rule still forbade every legal forced replacement and stopped the clone.

resolution.observed: Reloaded the corrected forced boundary and executed the legal Croakatoa replacement; it entered at 44/44 HP with no enemy reply and the battle returned to a command menu.

findings.why_bad: A rule for an active battler must never veto replacement choices after that battler has fainted.
findings.improvement: Every move-commit rule that forbids switching now requires forced_switch=false.
findings.next_test: Exercise every faint boundary in the next clone without PolicyError.

findings.summary: Turn 4 predicted 24-30 Bulldoze damage while RAM observed 9 because burn was omitted and Ponyta's earlier Play Rough lowered Attack before Lildozer acted.

resolution.observed: Reloading with scorer v5 reduced the pre-action burned Bulldoze range to 14-18. The remaining lower observed roll is explained by the verified Play Rough Attack drop occurring before the slower Bulldoze.

findings.improvement: Physical damage now applies burn unless the attacker has Guts; the next clone must continue treating Play Rough's Attack-drop branch as variance.
findings.next_test: Compare the next burned Bulldoze prediction with the observed post-Play-Rough stage and damage.

findings.summary: Two of six actions were switches, and the second switch was the earliest avoidable causal error.
findings.next_test: Count only voluntary switches and require each to survive the verified critical bound or be forced.

correct_choices: Turns 1-2 removed Bibarel with two verified Sparks.
Turn 3 sent the designated Ground reserve into Ponyta while it was full health.
Turn 4 used the intended Ground attack and correctly recorded the burn and Play Rough branch.
All six submitted actions matched the selected certificates; no hidden extra input or emulator discrepancy caused the stop.
agent_review.next_test: Run one full clone with behavior 4ef8a6d6 and reject any unsafe voluntary switch, forced-switch deadlock, or unreviewed damage mismatch.
